dz: 特萨洛尼察的教谕:特奥多修斯一世皇帝和他的同治皇帝格拉蒂安和瓦伦丁二世宣布他们希望所有罗马公民皈依尼斯涅基督教.
de: Edict of Thessalonica: Emperor Theodosius I and his co-emperors Gratian and Valentinian II declare their wish that all Roman citizens convert to Nicene Christianity.

te: Theodosius I makes his adventus, or formal entry, into Constantinople.
